whatWeDo: AI implementation for small businesses to optimize their workflow

services.name: Consulting
services.price: Pricing determined per project after meeting
services.notes: This service involves assessing your business needs and identifying opportunities for AI implementation to optimize your workflow. We will discuss your specific challenges and goals to tailor a solution that fits your business.

services.name: Implementation
services.price: One-time payment for building, monthly payment for maintenance
services.notes: This service includes the actual development and deployment of the AI solution. We will build the automation according to the agreed specifications, ensuring it integrates smoothly with your existing processes. After the initial setup, we offer ongoing maintenance to ensure everything runs efficiently.
